title: beanfmt configuration
description: Configuration file for beanfmt, a fast beancount file formatter with CJK support.

cost_column.description: Column to align costs (e.g. {100 USD}) to.

inline_comment_column.description: Column to align inline comments (;) to. 0 disables alignment (comment stays one space after the content).

thousands.description: Thousands separator handling. "add" inserts commas (1000000 → 1,000,000), "remove" strips commas (1,000,000 → 1000000), "keep" leaves as-is. Reaches the numbers selected by amount_scope.

decimal_mode.description: Decimal place normalization for amounts. "keep" leaves them as-is, "minimal" strips trailing zeros (5.60 → 5.6, 5.00 → 5), "pad" pads to decimal_places digits (5.6 → 5.60). Reaches the numbers selected by amount_scope.

decimal_places.description: Number of fractional digits to pad to when decimal_mode is "pad".

display_precision.description: Per-currency fraction width used instead of decimal_places when decimal_mode is "pad", written like Beancount's display_precision option: "CNY:0.01" gives two digits, "POINTS:1" none. Unlike decimal_places the width is exact, so extra trailing zeros are dropped (2900.00 → 2900); non-zero digits are kept. A later entry for the same currency wins.

amount_scope.description: Which numbers thousands and decimal_mode reach. "all" covers posting and balance amounts plus costs, price annotations and price directives; "amounts" covers posting and balance amounts only.

spaces_in_braces.description: Add spaces inside cost braces: { 100 USD } vs {100 USD}.

fixed_cjk_width.description: Treat CJK characters as double-width for alignment.

sort.description: Sort entries by date. Accepts "asc", "desc", "off", or a boolean (true = asc, false = off).

sort_timeless.description: Where to place entries without time metadata within a day. "begin" places them before timed entries, "end" places them after, "keep" preserves their original relative order.

sort_exclude.description: Directive types to exclude from sorting. Excluded directives act as sort barriers.
